description: Witness cases for tasks/transpiler-hardening-deferred.md — a DEFERRED cluster derived from the last 25 commits of the JVM Thunderduck (nubank/thunderduck). Each pins the τ Thunderduck-boundary gap where a raw spark.sql(...) wrapped by a DataFrame op routes to V2RelationConverter, which recurses to the nested RelType::Sql leaf and bails ('SQL text is owned by parser_v2, not V2RelationConverter') while Spark accepts it. All entries have "deferred": true — born RED and EXPECTED TO STAY red until the acceptance gate (τ routes nested SQL leaves through parser_v2). They are NOT in select_block_corpus_baseline.txt, so their redness is not a regression. Goldens were RE-RECORDED from live Apache Spark 4.1.1 (2026-07-15, Linux devcontainer) and are authoritative (id round-trips long/non-null); regenerate via `THUNDERDUCK_WORKTREE_ROOT=/workspace run-differential-tests.sh --record core -k sqlwrap`. Verified born-red 2026-07-15: τ errors 'unsupported proto shape RelType::Sql'.

witnesses.pins: plain SELECT wrapped by .limit — nested RelType::Sql leaf under Limit; Spark ok, τ boundary-errors
backtick-quoted identifiers under .limit — τ never reaches the parser that normalizes backticks (JVM: backticks leaked into DuckDB, 'syntax error at or near \`')
WITH CTE under .limit — JVM double-rendered the CTE body under a Limit wrapper; τ boundary-errors before any generation
SELECT wrapped by .filter — the gap is not limit-specific; ANY DataFrame op over a nested SQL leaf triggers it
SELECT under .offset+.limit — the Root->Limit->Offset->Sql plan shape that NPE'd the JVM DESCRIBE path; τ boundary-errors on the nested Sql leaf
